items.quote: OAuth 2.0 (OAuth) provides a way for your app users to grant limited access to their Smartsheet resources.
items.why: Quote states OAuth 2.0 grants limited access; no bearer_token, no client ID/secret detail.

items.quote: Apply your API access token in the Security tab by selecting the Bearer Token value field
items.why: Shows personal token in Bearer Token field; no oauth2, Gov/EU tokens.

items.quote: The Smartsheet API is restricted to users on Business and Enterprise plans
items.why: Plan restriction stated; no trial exclusion, no self_serve_trial detail, no Advanced Work Management.

items.quote: You can't generate API access tokens.
items.why: Says tokens can't be generated; unqualified, no trial mention. Consistent, not sufficient alone.
